name: chop_regime_c1
type: build, instrument check, interactive suite; not a phase; fits nothing (Cooper sets the filter by eye after the stop)
branch: explore/chop-regime-c1, cut from explore/shape-classifier-s2 at e71b68a
precedent_note: The brief names prompts/attention_threshold_suite.md as the precedent. That file does not exist in this checkout (it is referenced as future work in prompts/attention_excursion_b1_amendment_2.md and prompts/attention_excursion_b2.md; no commit on any local or origin branch has held it). The brief restates the shape and the prohibitions it borrows, so the build follows the brief's own text.

sources.quotes: data/filtered/<event_id>/quotes.parquet (+ quotes_repair_1c.parquet), columns sip_timestamp, sequence_number, bid_price, ask_price, bid_size, ask_size

R1_d32_exception.question: C1's suite puts F1-layer columns (turnover_t and turnover_rate, whose denominator is F1's share count, and the dilution flag) beside outcome panels: as a by-eye filter condition, in the G2 finder, and as a facet. D32 A1 allows that only as a pre-registered partition test; S1 needed D39 for less.
R1_d32_exception.answer: Log D41 exception (same shape as D39)
R1_d32_exception.effect: D41 appended to docs/Universe-Decisions.md in T0's commit beside D40; CLAUDE.md next free = D42. turnover_rate stays a relative condition, G2 keeps its turnover_t clause, the dilution flag stays a facet.

population.quarantine: slices.parquet slice == 'dev_quarantine' (50 dev_v3 + 6 dev_v4_sidecar): built for the section 6 controls, never embedded, never in the development-slice build
population.tau_source: results/shape_classifier/s2/artifacts/t1_group_a.parquet column c__tau_d_ns: S2's decision time at tau = max(stored tau, the crossing print's own timestamp) -- the tau S2 used for its entries (T2: tau = tau_d; entry = first print after it). int64 asserted on read.
population.v_pre_source: S2 t1_group_a c__ref_shares (shares traded from tau's segment start to tau_d; undefined when tau is in an auction minute)

moments.end: strictly before 20:00 ET on the event date
moments.weight_interval_convention: each moment represents the minutes ending at it: tau and tau+j (j <= 60) one minute each, tau+60+5i the five minutes (tau+60+5(i-1), tau+60+5i]. Asserted: sum of weights = (last moment - tau) / 1 min + 1.
moments.segments: research/attention_excursion_b1/common.py clock_segment (XNYS open/close, early closes included): premarket [04:00, open), auction_open [open, open+60s), regular [open+60s, close), auction_close [close, close+60s), after_hours [close+60s, 20:00)
moments.auction_moments: carried and labelled; every measure unavailable; not given slider values; not in the suite's filter table (their moment-minutes are counted in the header)
moments.halt_state: label: t inside a labelled halt interval whose start <= t; gap_proxy: t in regular hours and >= 300 s since the last print (b2/S2 HALT_GAP), with no label; none otherwise
moments.no_print_since_last_moment: no print in (previous moment, t]; FALSE at tau by definition
moments.quotes_available: event-level quotes_ingested per D15 (Phase 11's join: (ticker, event_date_canonical, round(momentum_pct, 2)) present in the Phase 4 sessions cache; momentum_pct is a join key only, D4). Per moment, quote_at_t additionally says whether a D17-valid quote prevails at t.
moments.tcs_state: S2 R1 causal tau_close_sensitive at each moment: s2common.tcs_state(tau_exact, tau_d, tau_mb_exact, t), tau_mb_exact from S2 t2_event_meta
moments.dilution: S2 t1_group_a c__dilution_tau (filings accepted before tau)

collapse.applied_per: clock segment, over the segment's prints from its start; causal (a print's fate depends only on earlier prints)

rate_ladder.rule: b2 R1, research/attention_excursion_b2/b2common.py::a2_ladder_r1 with t in place of tau and t's segment start as the anchor
rate_ladder.valid: a2_count_ladder's valid (both halves >= 17 collapsed trades and the D22 floor)

scale_free_ladder.W_k: H_t / 2^k, H_t = t - start of t's segment, window [t - W_k, t]
scale_free_ladder.generation: k = 0, 1, ... down to and including the first k whose window holds fewer than 64 collapsed trades (exact count, b2 R1 as ruled by Cooper); windows are nested so no finer rung can pass; also stops at a 10 ms half-window or k_max

declared_interpretations.two_finest_rungs: finest_rung (section 4a) = the smallest window valid under the 64-trade scale-free stop; it feeds er, vr, the own noise in cost_noise_h. finest_rate_rung = the smallest window valid under the rate ladder (17 per half-window); it feeds trade_rate, dollar_flow, turnover_rate, n_eff, top3_share, move_per_trade, spread_tw and the act_ratio numerator in the suite conditions and in G1 and G2. Per-rung values of every measure are kept in the artifacts.
declared_interpretations.relative_measures_ladder: n_eff_k, top3_share_k, move_per_trade_k are computed on the rate ladder's valid rungs (the relative rows sit with the rate measures in T3)
declared_interpretations.bucket_path: element 0 = the window's opening price on the same basis (VWAP basis: the first print in the window; midpoint basis: the D16 midpoint prevailing at that first print), elements 1..32 = bucket prices (VWAP, or the D16 midpoint at the bucket's last contributing print). 32 log returns. Brief 1's split-at-edges bucket rule, implemented on prefix sums; equality with instruments.bucketize is tested in T0 and value conservation is asserted in every window.
declared_interpretations.window_bounds: [t - W_k, t], both ends inclusive (Brief 1's a2_count_ladder convention); zero-size prints carry no volume and are counted, not bucketed
declared_interpretations.move_per_trade: abs(ln(last print in the window / first print in the window)) x 1e4 / collapsed trades in the window
declared_interpretations.n_eff_orders: prints grouped by their collapsed-order id (the D26 collapse over the segment); an order that began before the window counts once with its in-window volume
declared_interpretations.er: abs(sum r) / sum abs(r) over the 32 returns; unavailable ('flat') when sum abs(r) = 0
declared_interpretations.er_0: sqrt(2 / (pi n)) x s / mean|r - rbar|, n = 32, s = sqrt(mean((r - rbar)^2)) (ddof 0: the resampling null draws from the empirical distribution); unavailable when mean|r - rbar| = 0
declared_interpretations.variance_ratio: Lo and MacKinlay (1988): overlapping q-sums, sigma_a^2 with n - 1, sigma_c^2 with m = q (n - q + 1)(1 - q / n); robust z* = sqrt(n) (VR - 1) / sqrt(theta), theta = sum_{j=1}^{q-1} [2 (q - j) / q]^2 delta_j, delta_j = n sum (d_t^2 d_{t-j}^2) / (sum d_t^2)^2
declared_interpretations.own_noise: from the finest valid scale-free rung's 32 bucket log returns on the primary basis: wall h -> sqrt(sum r^2 / W_minutes x h); volume m -> sqrt(sum r^2 / window shares x m V_pre); cost_noise_h = spread_bp_t / (1e4 sigma_h)
declared_interpretations.every_valid_rung: the scale-free 'at every valid rung' option and G2's 'every valid rung 1-4' range over valid rungs k >= 1 (rung 0 is context, section 4a) and require at least one valid rung
declared_interpretations.context_rung0: section 4d reads rung 0 = [segment start, t] bucketed to 32 and requires the same 64-trade stop. leg = the pair i < j on the 33-point path maximising lp_j - lp_i; leg_s = (lp_j - lp_i) / sqrt(sum of r^2 over returns i+1..j); leg high = the earliest point within ln(1 + 1e-9) of the maximum after the low (tie rule A2.3). Price at t: midpoint basis = the D16 midpoint prevailing at t; VWAP basis = the last print at or before t. giveback unavailable when the leg is zero. since_high_min from the leg high's bucket time (its last contributing print; element 0 = the window's first print).
declared_interpretations.quote_at_t: D16: the last D17-valid quote (sorted by sip_timestamp, sequence_number) with sip_timestamp <= t, restricted to t's Phase 11 segment (premarket [04:00, open), rth [open, close), post [close, 20:00)) exactly as Phase 11's ASOF join; a quote at the same sip_timestamp as t prevails
declared_interpretations.quote_age: t minus the last change of best bid price or best ask price among D17-valid quotes in the same Phase 11 segment (Phase 11's BBO change marker, sizes ignored)
declared_interpretations.spread_tw: time-weighted over [a, t] with Phase 11's rule: every quote row's duration runs to the next row (or the segment end); excluded rows' time is dropped from the average
declared_interpretations.turnover: turnover_t = shares traded 04:00 -> t / S2 c__shs_tau_corrected; shs_tau_asof_ns < t and shs_tau_accepted_ns < t asserted per moment. F1's shs_quality is carried beside it (it describes F1's t0 value; S2 re-anchored the count at tau)
declared_interpretations.depth_multiplier: shares per displayed size unit, per year, from the T0 census (1 if sizes are shares, 100 if round lots)

quote_size_census.rule_shares: share of D17-valid nonzero sizes that are multiples of 100 >= 0.95 AND median over at-touch trades of (trade size / displayed size on the touched side) <= 1
quote_size_census.rule_lots: share of multiples of 100 <= 0.05 AND that median ratio >= 10
quote_size_census.otherwise: unit not established for that year -> escalation row 4 (LOG); depth not built for that year
quote_size_census.at_touch: trade price equal to the D16 contemporaneous ask (buyer at the touch) or bid (seller at the touch), regular hours

hindsight.entry: the first non-spike print with sip_timestamp > t (S2's zero-latency convention)
hindsight.spike_guard: Brief 1's rule (3% from both neighbours which agree within 3%), vectorised as s2common.spike_flags over the event day's 04:00-20:00 prints; spike prints are skipped for entry, exit, MFE and MAE
hindsight.window: (t, end], end = t + h (wall) or the print at which shares traded after t first reach m x V_pre (volume)
hindsight.censoring: the forward window is cut at 20:00 and at the end of t's segment (premarket -> XNYS open, regular -> XNYS close, after hours -> 20:00) and flagged h_censored; a volume target not reached by then is cut and flagged the same way
hindsight.v_pre_undefined: volume horizons are undefined where V_pre is undefined (tau in an auction minute)
hindsight.columns: fwd_ret_h (last non-spike print <= end vs entry), fwd_mfe_h (highest), fwd_mae_h (lowest); bp and cents, gross; net = gross - the round trip at t (spread_bp_t, spread_c_t), unavailable without a quote at t
hindsight.rem_type: S2 t3a_remaining_labels rem_type at time keys tau, w1, w2, w5, w10, w20 mapped to moments j = 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20; S2's d_ns for each asserted equal to the C1 moment

galleries.label: gallery finder, not a filter

G2_higher_float_noise.scale_free_rule: both clauses hold at every valid rung k in 1..4; at least one valid

G3_pause_between_legs.hindsight: max non-spike print in (t, t + 60 min], cut at 20:00, exceeds the leg high by >= (ask - bid at t) in dollars AND ln(max / leg high) >= sigma_w60 (the own noise over 60 min)

galleries.near_the_line: drawn live from all build-time pools (G1, G2, G3, random): the k pooled moments nearest the most recently moved threshold on each side, k default 12

strip.from: max(start of t's segment, t - 60 min)
strip.downsample: keep the window's highest and lowest print and the prints nearest t, then an even stride
strip.quotes: D17-valid bid and ask as step lines, at most 1000 change points

controls.population: the 56 quarantined events (dev_v3 50 + dev_v4 sidecar 6), every non-auction moment, every valid scale-free rung

negative_references.er_ratio_statistic: median over windows of (mean over resamples of er) / er_0, per rung
negative_references.vz_statistic: pooled over windows and resamples, per rung

negative_whole_pipeline.vwap: the window's print-to-print log returns shuffled, re-integrated from the first print's price with every print's time and size kept, then bucketed exactly as real data
negative_whole_pipeline.midpoint: the window's quote-update-level log midpoint changes (D17-valid quotes, the midpoint prevailing at the first print as the start) shuffled, re-integrated with the quote times kept, then sampled at the first print and each bucket's last print
negative_whole_pipeline.bands: the negative_references bands, per basis, per rung; er statistic = median over windows of the mean over shuffles of er_rel

positive_trend.construction: demeaned resampled returns + d x s x sqrt(n) / n per step (d own-noise units across the window)
positive_trend.pass: median er_rel increases with d and exceeds 2.0 at d = 4

positive_autocorrelation.construction: x_1 = e_1, x_t = phi x_(t-1) + e_t over the demeaned resampled returns
positive_autocorrelation.pass: median vz2 >= +1.64 at phi = +0.5 and <= -1.64 at phi = -0.5

controls.gated_bases: the positive controls and the reference control are gated on every basis that the whole-pipeline control keeps; a basis dropped by the ruling table is reported, not gated

null_parameter_sweep.note: a label, not a gate; relative change of a median near zero is reported with its absolute value beside it

blindness.tolerance_rule: identical to 1e-9 = numpy.isclose(a, b, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-9), with NaN and inf patterns equal. Set 2026-09-30 before the T5 run, after a one-event smoke run (MATX_2020-07-10) showed er_mid exactly 0 at x1 and 4e-15 at x0.1 (a midpoint (0.1 bid + 0.1 ask) / 2 is not bit-equal to 0.1 x (bid + ask) / 2), where a relative-only test is undefined; the relative-only worst case is reported beside it.
blindness.invariant: scale-free and bp measures (er, er_rel, vr, vz, leg_s, giveback, spread_bp, spread_tw_bp, cost_noise_h, move_per_trade, n_eff, top3_share, trade_rate, turnover_rate, act_ratio)
blindness.rounding: trade and quote prices below $1 rounded to the $0.01 grid; change reported per event

controls.price_basis_agreement: Spearman of vz2 and er_rel, midpoint vs VWAP, per rung and segment, real data (the 56 events in T5; the development slice in T6)
controls.causality_test: every measure function fed a print and a quote 1 ns after t must raise
controls.segment_test: a window crossing a segment boundary, and one containing an auction minute, must raise

primary_basis_ruling.mid_pass_vwap_pass: midpoint primary; VWAP carried as the check
primary_basis_ruling.mid_pass_vwap_fail: midpoint; VWAP dropped from the suite
primary_basis_ruling.no_quote_fallback: windows lacking a D16 midpoint at any of the 33 points use VWAP, flagged price_basis = vwap_fallback

suite.encoding: typed arrays, byte-plane shuffled, gzip, base64; decoded in the browser with the built-in DecompressionStream (no library)

sample.rule: the largest fraction f on a 0.01 grid such that ceil(f x n_stratum) events of every stratum (a seeded permutation, whole events only) fit the budget

suite.header: Development slice only (2020–22). Thresholds in absolute units, per segment. Hindsight columns are for judgement, never conditions. Commit before any 2023–24 read. 2025 is sealed. The galleries are the evidence; the curves summarise them.

conditions.default_state: off; on switch-on the slider starts at the embedded min (for >) or max (for <) of that segment's values, which filters nothing
conditions.override_scope: rescues only from relative and scale-free conditions, never from presence and cost

noise_band.cells: segment x floor(log2(minutes since tau)) (tau itself its own cell)

suite.outcome_weights: every count, share, ECDF and median is weighted by moment-minutes
suite.units_in_browser: net = gross - the round trip at t; cents outcomes = bp x entry price / 100 (both embedded measurements); nothing else is computed from embedded values except the filter itself and the chop label

escalation.1: any causality assertion fires -> HARD STOP
escalation.2: any segment assertion fires -> HARD STOP
escalation.3: any section 6 control misses its pass band -> HARD STOP
escalation.4: quote-size units cannot be established for a year -> LOG; depth not built for that year
escalation.5: embedded sample below 50% of development-slice events -> LOG; header states the fraction
escalation.6: moments with no valid scale-free rung above 40% of moment-minutes in any segment -> LOG
escalation.7: events with quotes unavailable -> LOG with count; own facet value
escalation.8: A12 or any hindsight column reaches the suite's condition inputs -> HARD STOP (build assertion)
escalation.9: any embedded row outside the development slice -> HARD STOP (build assertion)
escalation.10: extrapolated runtime above 6 hours -> HARD STOP; post; do not shrink grid, ladder or population silently

excluded.flag_cross_session_extreme: A12: excluded entirely, including as a facet (S2 T0; Amendment 1 A1.6)
excluded.momentum_pct: D4: join key only (the D15 coverage join), never a measure or facet

amendment_1.A1_1_variance_ratio: dropped: vr2, vr4, vz2, vz4 are not built (measures.scale_free returns er, er0, er_rel, sum_r2); no VR condition; the AR(1) positive control is retired

A1_2_primary_basis.rule: per window: er and sum_r2 on the midpoint where the window's 33-point D16 midpoint path exists, else VWAP with price_basis = vwap_fallback; the moment's primary columns follow its finest valid rung (er, cost_noise_h) or rung 0 (context)

A1_3_null.construction_vwap: the window's print-to-print log returns (every print in [a, t]), demeaned, drawn with replacement, re-integrated from the first print's log price with every print's time and size kept, then bucketed exactly as real data (measures.vwap_log_path: deviation from the synthetic first print with volume)
A1_3_null.construction_mid: the D17-valid quotes from the one prevailing at the window's first print through t: log midpoint changes, demeaned, drawn with replacement, re-integrated from the prevailing midpoint with the quote times kept, sampled at the first print and each bucket's last print
A1_3_null.rng: numpy default_rng([seed, S1 event_index, j, k, basis code (mid 0, vwap 1), 31])
A1_3_null.cells: t's segment (premarket, regular, after_hours) x rung k x price tier at tau (S1 s1_events price_tier: <$1, $1-3, $3-10, >=$10) x basis
A1_3_null.dev_sample: per cell, every valid scale-free window of the development-slice build ranked by u = default_rng([seed, event_index, j, k, 97]).random(); the 2,000 smallest u kept (all when fewer)
A1_3_null.output: per cell: windows in the cell, windows sampled, finite draws, null median, 5th and 95th values (pooled over sampled windows x draws); cells with fewer than 20 sampled windows labelled
A1_3_null.fallback_reference: a vwap_fallback window reads the VWAP null of its cell
A1_3_null.suite_condition: er < x on the primary basis, at a chosen rung (0-6) or at every valid rung k >= 1 (max over those rungs < x); er_rel and er_0 are columns, not conditions
A1_3_null.G2_revised: turnover_t < 0.01 AND dollar_flow >= $20,000/min at the finest rate rung AND at every valid scale-free rung k in 1..4 (at least one valid) er (that rung's primary basis) inside its cell's null [5th, 95th] values

A1_4_controls.population: the 53 quarantined events with tau, every valid scale-free window
A1_4_controls.negative: the A1.3 null on every window of the 53 events, per cell and basis; reported, no band

positive_trend.construction: the same null draws (same seed) plus d x sd(demeaned steps) / sqrt(n steps) per step, i.e. d own-noise units of the null walk across the window
positive_trend.pass: in every cell (segment x rung x tier, per basis) holding at least 20 windows: median er at d = 4 above that cell's 53-event null 95th value

blindness.tolerance_rule: numpy.isclose(a, b, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-9), NaN and inf patterns equal
blindness.relative_and_context_rule: declared: the amendment names presence/cost (3a) and scale-free (3b) only; a relative or context measure failing blindness is handled as 3b (LOG, removed from conditions / the override, kept as a column, shown in the header)

A1_4_controls.price_basis_agreement: Spearman of er, midpoint vs VWAP, per rung and segment (the 53 events in T5; the development slice in T6)

A1_5_escalation.3a: a presence or cost measure fails blindness -> HARD STOP
A1_5_escalation.3b: a scale-free measure fails its positive or blindness control -> LOG; removed from the suite's conditions, kept as a column, failure shown in the suite header; the build continues

amendment_1.panel_B_references: er: the cell's null 5-95% band and median beside the real er distribution (per rung, for t's segment and the tier in view); cost_noise_h = 1; the flat Phase 11 stack (70.98 bp, 2.512 cents) on the spread panels
amendment_1.artifact_storage: T6's per-moment and per-rung tables (and their parts) are regenerable from committed config + code and are expected to exceed GitHub's per-file limit (sizes recorded in the manifest); they are git-ignored under results/chop_regime/c1/artifacts/t6_*.parquet and results/chop_regime/c1/cache/ (the Agent_Prompt_Standard v1.3 SS12 precedent in .gitignore), with a tracked t6_manifest.json (rows, columns, sha256 per file)

amendment_2.A2_1_ruling: the positive trend control is read per rung, pooled over segments and tiers (24 of 24 rung-bases with >= 20 windows pass; VWAP passes all 101 gated cells); er is reinstated as a condition: er < x at a chosen rung (0-6) or at every valid rung k >= 1, per segment. t5_summary.json keeps the per-cell reading as run.

A2_1_ceiling_label.where: panel B's er panel and the er condition row, per cell (t's segment x rung x price tier x basis) of t6b_null_bands
A2_1_ceiling_label.rule: a label, not a rule; nothing is excluded

amendment_2.A2_2_bucket_line: er is read only against its own 32-bucket null band; its level depends on the bucket count by construction.
amendment_2.A2_3_panel_A: per-segment counts first, the pooled total last in smaller type
amendment_2.A2_4_unchanged: the 0.44 embedded sample (3,319 of 7,525 events) and every other result at bcf6fbf; only T8 is rebuilt, from the T6 / T6b / T7 outputs on disk; no measure is recomputed

amendment_3.suite_unchanged: chop_suite.html is not rebuilt (config cdbc5343fba6, data 237f7165c992)

W1_sample.eligible: every development-slice event with tau; the quarantine excluded
W1_sample.order: within each stratum a seeded permutation; events enter in increasing (rank - 0.5) / stratum size (proportional allocation; ties by event_id)
W1_sample.rule: the longest prefix of that order, at most 600, whose page fits the budget

W1_candles.prints: c1common.Tape: every print 04:00-20:00 (inclusive of 20:00:00.000) from read_trades, no condition-code filter -- the prints every C1 measure and the b1 / b2 / S1 / S2 tick builds read
W1_candles.minute: floor((sip_timestamp - 04:00 ET) / 60 s); open / close = first / last print of the minute in (sip_timestamp, sequence_number) order; high / low = max / min; volume = shares
W1_candles.range: first event-day print's minute to the last print's minute; a minute with no print has no candle (NaN) and volume 0
W1_candles.spike_guard: not applied (the measures read the same unguarded prints)

W1_marks.halts: labels (participation_exit_overlay load_halt_labels) plus every consecutive-print gap >= 300 s with both prints in [XNYS open, close)
W1_marks.segments: XNYS open and close of the event date (early closes included); auction minutes [open, open + 60 s) and [close, close + 60 s)
W1_marks.type: S1 theory type at N = 100 (s1_theory_types, typed only)

W2_grid.rule: measures.build_event with the config's moments.wall_minutes_every_1 set to 960 for the wall events: moments at tau + j min for every j until 20:00, weight 1; the measure code and its assertions unchanged
W2_grid.flags: g1, g2 (the t6b bands), g3 (hindsight) per minute from t7_galleries.flags; viewing labels only
W2_grid.embedded: condition, override and er columns, segment, flags; no hindsight value

W3_page.filter_code: the suite's filter functions (val, hval, recompute, noFilterValue, rangeOf, ...) are extracted from t8_suite.PAGE by name, so both instruments run the same code
W3_page.config_format: the suite's export JSON; the wall loads and exports it
W3_page.round_trip: node: 25 seeded configs set in the suite's code and exported -> loaded into the wall; 25 set in the wall and exported -> loaded into the suite's code (the wall's loader injected into the test context; the suite page has no Load button and is not rebuilt); filter state compared minute for minute on every shared (event, t)

amendment_3.W4_timing: slider redraw for a full page of 12 measured in headless Chrome (real Plotly) through the DevTools protocol; row W-e LOG above 1 s

escalation.W-a: causality or segment assertion fires in W2 -> HARD STOP
escalation.W-b: a non-development row, A12, or a hindsight or type column reaches the condition set -> HARD STOP
escalation.W-c: the config round trip with the suite disagrees on any minute -> HARD STOP
escalation.W-e: slider redraw over 1 s for a page of 12 -> LOG
